data.content_ref: inline:Develop an incremental algorithm that maintains the grounded extension under single-edge additions and deletions using a memoized affected region and local re-computation of the least fixed point. The semantics is unchanged, but the expansion is in operational strength: amortized polynomial updates. This is valuable for interactive conjecture refinement where edges are added as warrants evolve. Criticizable: worst-case complexity may degrade; memory overhead of dependency tracking is nontrivial; the proposal does not expand the expressiveness of the semantics.
